classification.difficultyReason: Choose intermediate sides or angles within the supplied sine-rule hint and convert metres to square centimetres.

inlines.text: Calculate the area of these triangles. Answer in square cm to 1 d.p.
(Hint: Use sine rule and angle sum of a triangle)

spec.description: Unlettered source-shaped triangle with left, top-right and bottom-right vertices. 17.7 cm above upper edge, 10.1 cm outside lower-left edge and 74 degrees inside bottom-right corner. No angle arc.
spec.mathematics: 17.7 cm opposite 74 degrees; 10.1 cm opposite top-right angle. Right edge unlabelled. Source is not to scale; coordinate names are not printed.

answer.worked:
Let $\theta$ be the top-right angle and $\phi$ the left angle.
$$\begin{align*}
\frac{\sin\theta}{10.1}&=\frac{\sin74^\circ}{17.7}\\[8pt]
\theta&=\sin^{-1}\!\left(\frac{10.1\sin74^\circ}{17.7}\right)\\[8pt]
\phi&=180^\circ-74^\circ-\theta\\[8pt]
A&=\frac12(17.7)(10.1)\sin\phi\\[8pt]
A&\approx85.4\text{ cm}^2
\end{align*}$$
The supplementary value of $\theta$ would make the angle sum exceed $180^\circ$.

spec.description: Unlettered black triangle with top apex and a base rising slightly right; 15.3 cm outside left slope, 48 degrees inside bottom-left corner and 67 degrees inside bottom-right corner. No arcs.
spec.mathematics: Left side 15.3 cm is opposite 67 degrees; bottom-left angle 48 degrees. Remaining sides unlabelled. Preserve source not-to-scale silhouette.

answer.worked:
Let $\theta$ be the top angle and $b$ the base length.
$$\begin{align*}
\theta&=180^\circ-48^\circ-67^\circ=65^\circ\\[8pt]
\frac{b}{\sin65^\circ}&=\frac{15.3}{\sin67^\circ}\\[8pt]
b&=\frac{15.3\sin65^\circ}{\sin67^\circ}\\[8pt]
A&=\frac12(15.3)\left(\frac{15.3\sin65^\circ}{\sin67^\circ}\right)\sin48^\circ\\[8pt]
A&\approx85.6\text{ cm}^2
\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Unlettered tall black triangle with bottom-left, top and right vertices; 75 degrees inside top corner, 18 degrees inside bottom-left corner and 0.53 m outside lower-right edge. No arcs or right-angle marker.
spec.mathematics: 0.53 m opposite 75 degrees; bottom-left angle 18 degrees. Other sides unlabelled. Preserve source not-to-scale silhouette.

answer.worked:
$0.53\text{ m}=53\text{ cm}$. Let $\theta$ be the rightmost angle and $s$ the side opposite it.
$$\begin{align*}
\theta&=180^\circ-75^\circ-18^\circ=87^\circ\\[8pt]
\frac{s}{\sin87^\circ}&=\frac{53}{\sin75^\circ}\\[8pt]
s&=\frac{53\sin87^\circ}{\sin75^\circ}\\[8pt]
A&=\frac12(53)\left(\frac{53\sin87^\circ}{\sin75^\circ}\right)\sin18^\circ\\[8pt]
A&\approx448.7\text{ cm}^2
\end{align*}$$
